P. rarely Ā., 4. P. (तपति, तप्यति; तप्त) 
__1 (Intransitively used) 
___(a) To shine, blaze (as fire or sun); तमस्तपति घर्मांशौ कथमाविर्भविष्यति [[Ś. 5. 14]]; [[

.]] 
___(b) To be hot or warm, give out heat. 
___(c) To suffer pain; तपति न सा किसलयशयनेन [[

.]] 
___(d) To mortify the body, undergo penance (with तपस्); अगणिततनूतापं तप्त्वा तपांसि भगीरथः [[

.]] 
__2 (Transitively used) 
___(a) To make hot, heat, warm; [[
]]; पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रं स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम् [[

.]] 
___(b) To inflame, burn, consume by heat; तपति तनुगात्रि मदनस्त्बामनिशं मां पुनर्दहत्येव [[Ś. 3. 16.]]; अङ्गैरनङ्गतप्तैः 3. 6. 
___(c) To hurt, injure, damage, spoil; यास्यन् सुतस्तप्यति मां समन्युम् [[

.]] 
___(d) To pain, distress. 
___(e) mortify the body, undergo penance (with तपस्). -Pass. (तप्यते) (regarded by some as a root of the 4th conjugation) 
__1 To be heated, suffer pain. 
__2 To undergo severe penance (oft. with तपस्); शम्बूको नाम वृषलः पृथिव्यां तप्यते तपः [[

U. or Caus. (तापयति-ते, तापित) 
__1 To heat, make warm; गगनं तापितपायितासिलक्ष्मीम् [[Śi. 20. 75]]; न हि तापयितुं शक्यं सागराम्भस्तृणोल्कया [[

.]] 
__2 To torment, pain, distress; भृशं तापितः कन्दर्पेण [[

.]] -With निस् 
__1 to heat. 
__2 to purify. 
__3 to burnish. 
-वि 
__1 to shine (Ātm. like उत्तप् q. v.); रबिर्वितपतेऽत्यर्थम् [[

a. [तप्-अच्] 
__1 Burning, warming, consuming by heat. 
__2 Causing pain or trouble, distressing. 
-पः 
__1 Heat, fire, warmth. 
__2 The sun; तपतपनसहस्रद्योतबद्दुनिंरीक्ष्यम् (तेजः) [[Rām.

.]] 
__3 The hot season; [[Śi. 1. 66.]] 
__4 Penance, religious austerities. 
-Comp. 
-अत्ययः, -अन्तः the end of the hot season and the beginning of the rainy season; रविपीतजला तपात्यये पुनरोघेन हि युज्यते नदी [[

__1 The river Tāptī. 
__2 N. of a daughter of the sun, married to Samvarṇa and mother of Kuru.

a. [तप्-ल्यु] 
__1 Warming, heating, burning, shining &c. 
__2 Causing distress, paining; ब्रह्मद्विषस्तपनो [Page0760-2] मनुमीरसि [[

.]] 
__4 The hot season. 
__5 The sun-stone. 
__6 N. of a hell; [[

.]] 
__7 An epithet of Śiva. 
__8 The Arka plant. 
__9 N. of Agastya. 
-नम् 
__1 Heat, burning. 
__2 Paining, grieving. 
__3 Mental agony, anguish. 
-Comp. 
-अंशुः, -करः, -दीधितिः 
__1 the sun. 
__2 a sun-beam. 
-आत्मजः, -तनयः an epithet (1) of Yama. (2) of Karṇa. (3) of Sugrīva. 
-आत्मजा, -तनया an epithet of the Yamunā and of the Godāvarī. 
-इष्टम् copper. 
-उपलः, -मणिः the sun-stone; निर्वाणमनु निर्बाति तपनं तपनोपलः [[Rāj.

.]] 
-च्छदः the sun-flower. 
-द्युतिः f. 
__1 the heat of the sun; [[Śi. 1. 42.]] 
__2 the sun-shine.

a. [तप्-णिच् भावे-ल्युट्] 
__1 Heating, inflaming. 
__2 Distressing. 
__3 Illuminating; अतप्यत स्माखिललोकतापनम् [[

.]] 
-नः 
__1 The sun. 
__2 The hot season. 
__3 The sun-stone. 
__4 N. of one of the arrows of Cupid. 
-नम् 
__1 Burning. 
__2 Distressing. 
__3 Chastising. 
__4 A division of hell. 
__5 Gold. 
__6 (in drama) Helplessness, perplexity. 
-ना Austerity. 
-नी N. of several Upaniṣads.

__1 The river Godāvarī or the river Tāptī. 
__2 Heat; तेजिष्ठया तपनी रक्षसस्तप [[

a. 
__1 To be heated. 
__2 To be suffered or practised (as a penance). 
-यम् Gold; especially gold purified with fire; तपनीयाशोकः [[

a. Golden. 
-यम् Gold of the weight of a निष्क.

n. [तप्-असुन्] 
__1 Warmth, heat, fire, light; एकः सूर्यस्तंपसो योनिरेका [[

.]] 
__3 Penance, religious austerity, mortification; तपः किलेदं तदवाप्तिसाधनम् [[

.]] 
__4 Meditation connected with the practice of personal self-denial or bodily mortification; गिरा बाऽऽशंसामि तपसा ह्यनन्तौ [[

.]] 
__5 Moral virtue, merit. 
__6 Special duty or observance (of any particular caste); यत्सप्तान्नानि मेधया तपसाजनयत्पिता [[Bṛ.

.]] 
__7 One of the seven worlds; i. e. the region above the world called जनस्. 
__8 The month of religious austerities. 
__9 A long period of time, Kalpa. 
__10 (In astrol.) The ninth lunar mansion. 
__11 Chastisement (दण्ड); आयुः शक्तिं च कालं च निर्दिश्य तप आदिशेत् [[

.]] -m. 
__1 The month of Māgha; तपसि मन्दगभस्तिरभीषुमान् [[Śi. 6. 63.]] 
__2 An epithet of Agni. -m., -n. 
__1 The cold season; (शिशिर). 
__2 The winter (हेमन्त). 
__3 The hot season (ग्रीष्म). 
-Comp. 
-अनुभावः the influence of religious penance. 
-अर्थीय a. destined for austerities; तपोर्थीयं ब्राह्मणी धत्त गर्भम् [[

.]] 
-अवटः the Brahmāvarta country. 
-कर a. undergoing penance; also तपस्कर. 
-करः the mango-fish (Polynemus Risua). 
-कृश a. emaciated by austerities 
-क्लेशः the pain of religious austerity. 
-गच्छः (also तपागच्छः) the 6th गच्छ of the Śvetāmbara Jainas. 
-चरणम्, -चर्या the practice of penance. तक्षः, -तङ्कः an epithet of Indra. 
-धन a. 
__1 rich in religious penance. 
__2 pious, ascetic. 
__3 consisting in penance, 
(-नः) ‘rich in penance’, an ascetic, devotee; रम्यास्तपोधनाना क्रियाः [[Ś. 1. 13]]; शमप्रधानेषु तपोधनेषु 2. 7; 4. 1; [[Śi. 1. 23]]; [[

.]] 
-निधिः an eminently pious [Page0761-1] man, an ascetic; [[

.]] 
-प्रभावः, -बलम् the power acquired by religious austerities; efficacy or potency of devotion. 
-भृत् a. ascetic, pious. 
-मूर्तिः 
__1 an ascetic. 
__2 the Supreme spirit. 
-मूल a. founded on religious austerity; तपोमूलमिदं सर्वं दैबमानुषकं सुखम् [[

.]] 
-राजः the moon. 
-राशिः 
__1 an ascetic. 
__2 N. of Viṣṇu (पुरुषोत्तम). 
-लोकः the region above the world called जनस्; [[

.]] 
-वनम् a penance-grove, a sacred grove in which ascetics practise penance; कृतं त्बयोपवनं तपोवनमिति प्रेक्षे [[Ś. 1]]; [[

]]; 2. 18. 
-वासः a place of penance or religious austerities. 
-विशेषः excellence of devotion, pre-eminent religious austerities. 
-वृद्ध a. very ascetic or devout. 
-शील a. inclined to practise penance. 
-समाधिः the practice of penance or religious austerities; तपःसमाधेः प्रतिकूलवर्ती [[

.]] 
-स्थली 
__1 a seat of religious austerity. 
__2 N. of Benares.

__1 The sun. 
__2 The moon. 
__3 A bird.

a. Produced by heat. 
-स्यः 
__1 The month of Phālguna; [[

.]] 
__2 An epithet of Arjuna. 
-स्या Religious austerity, penance; (also m. and n.); अथास्य बुद्धिरभवत्तपस्ये भरतर्षभ [[
Den. P. To practise penance; सुरासुरगुरुः सोऽत्र सपत्नीकस्तपस्यति [[Ś. 7. 9]], 12; [[

a. Ved. 
__1 Burning, hot; तपा तपिष्ठ तपसा तपस्वान् [[

a. 
__1 Practising penance, devout. 
__2 Poor, miserable, helpless, pitiable; सा तपस्विनी निर्वृता भवतु [[Ś. 4]]; [[

.]] 
__2 A mendicant, pauper. 
__3 An epithet of Nārada. 
__4 A sparrow. 
__5 A mango-fish; (see तपस्कर). 
-नी 
__1 female ascetic. 
__2 A poor or wretched woman. 
-Comp. 
-पत्रः the sun-flower.

.]] 
__2 Distressed, pained; नातितृप्यति मे चित्तं सुचिरं तापतापितम् [[
a. Ved. Burning hot; कृष्णाध्वा तपू रण्वश्चिकेत [[
]]] Burning hot; तपूंषि तस्मै वृजिनानि सन्तु [[

.]] -m. 
__1 Fire. 
__2 The sun. 
__3 An enemy; -n. Heat; नमस्ते हेतये तपुषे च कृण्मः [[

a. 
__1 Consisting in religious penance; एतान्यदर्शन्गुरवः पुराणाः स्वान्येव तेजांसि तपोमयानि [[

.]] 
__2 Practising penace, devout. 
-यः The Supreme Being.

p. p. [तप्-क्त] 
__1 Heated, burnt. 
__2 Red-hot. 
__3 Melted, fused. 
__4 Distressed, pained, afflicted, 
__5 Practised (as penance). 
__6 (in Astr.) Opposed by. 
-प्तम् Hot water. 
-Comp. 
-काञ्चनम् gold purified with fire. 
-कुम्भः, -कूपः N. of a hell. 
-कृच्छ्रम् a kind of penance consisting in drinking hot water, milk and ghee for three days each, and inhaling hot air for three days; [[

.]] 
-तप्त made hot repeatedly. 
-ताम्रम् red hot or melted copper; [[

.]] 
-पाषाणकुण्डम् N. of a hell; [[L. D. B.]] 
-मुद्रा Mark of divine weapons stamped on the body by devotees with heated metals. 
-रूपम्, -रूपकम् purified silver. 
-लोमशः green vitriol. 
-लोहम्, -वालुकः, -शूर्मिकुण्डम्, -सुराकुण्डम्, -सूर्मिः N. of different hells. 
-वालुकाः hot gravel; भुङ्क्ष्वैता भूयसी राजन्नर्जितास्तप्तवालुकाः [[

.]] 
__2 Torment, pain, affliction, misery, agony; इतरतापशतानि तवेच्छया वितर तानि सहे चतुरानन [[Udb.]]; समस्तापः कामं मनसिजनिदाघप्रसरयोः [[Ś. 3. 8]]; [[

.]] 
__3 Sorrow, distress. 
__4 A circle or heap of rays; प्रतिरूपं यथैवाप्सु तापः सूर्यस्य लक्ष्यते [[

]]; 10. 79. 20. 
-Comp. 
-त्रयम् the three kinds of miseries which human beings have to suffer in this world i. e. आध्यात्मिक, आधिदैविक and आधिभौतिक. 
-हर a. 
__1 removing heat, cooling 
__2 consoling. 
-री A sort of soup of pulse and grain.

a. [तप्-ण्बुल्] Heating, burning, inflaming. 
-कः 
__1 Fever, morbid heat. 
__2 A cooking stove or frying pan. 
__3 A boiler.

a. 
__1 Suffering from a disease (moral or physical.). 
__2 Heating. 
__3 Hot. 
__4 Causing pain, exciting; [[
An epithet of Kuru; also of Arjuna; सोऽहं त्वयेह विजितः संख्ये तापत्यवर्धन [[

a. 
(-सी f.) 
__1 Relating to religious penance or to an ascetic; तापसेष्वेव विप्रेषु यात्रिकं भैक्षमाहरेत् [[

.]] 
__2 Devout. 
-सः 
(-सी f.) A hermit, devotee, an ascetic. 
-Comp. 
-इष्टा, -प्रिया a grape. 
-तरुः, द्रुमः the tree of ascetics, also called इङ्गुदी.
(= कुतापसः) The wretch of an ascetic; अयं तापसकान् ध्वंसः [[
Asceticism; तापस्ये मे मनस्तात वर्तते कुरुनन्दन [[
The Tamāla tree or its flower (-n.); प्रफुल्लतापिच्छनिभैरभीषुभिः [[Śi. 1. 22]]; व्योम्नस्तापिच्छगुच्छावलिभिरिव तमोवल्लरीभिर्व्रियन्ते [[
